title: sync fails to remove directories on the destination that do not exist on the source
body:
#### What is the problem you are having with rclone?

I have noticed that under some circumstances (in my case, using a crypted remote) `rclone sync` fails to remove directories that should be removed since they do not exist on the source.  In my particular circumstance, it seems like the problem is that `rclone sync` uses something like the `rmdir` command, which (somewhat silently) fails if the directory has any contents left, even broken contents that `rclone` is ignoring.

I think this could be fixed by making the `sync` use `purge` functionality instead of `rmdir` to remove directories that don't exist on the source.

Here is the output from the `rclone sync` command, which claims that it has deleted 23 directories.

```
> rclone sync --progress --bwlimit 1M --links --track-renames --track-renames-strategy size,leaf,modtime --transfers 10 --max-backlog 20 --tpslimit 40 /raid/audio odc:audio
Transferred:              0 B / 0 B, -, 0 B/s, ETA -
Checks:            296345 / 296345, 100%
Deleted:                0 (files), 23 (dirs)
Elapsed time:     13m50.5s
```

However, a subsequent run of the sync without any changes being made still shows it trying to remove the 23 directories it claimed it had removed on the last run.  Note that no warnings or errors were reported at all (which is a separate problem).

So I ran again with `-v` to see what was going on with the directories it thought it was removing and got messages like this:

```
2022-09-12 16:44:10 INFO  : work/new/waiting/Johann_Sebastian_Bach_Canadian_Brass_-_Art_Of_The_Fugue: Removing directory
2022-09-12 16:44:10 INFO  : work/new/waiting/Johann Sebastian Bach; Canadian Brass - Art of the Fugue: Removing directory
```

Note that again, even with `-v`, no warnings or errors are reported with the supposedly removed directories.

So I tried manually listing (with `lsl`) one of the problem directories:

```
> rclone lsl odc:audio/work/new/waiting/Johann_Sebastian_Bach_Canadian_Brass_-_Art_Of_The_Fugue
>
```

Apparently no contents.  So I tried `rmdir` on that directory:

```
> rclone rmdir odc:audio/work/new/waiting/Johann_Sebastian_Bach_Canadian_Brass_-_Art_Of_The_Fugue2022/09/12 16:48:06 ERROR : Attempt 1/3 failed with 1 errors and: folder not empty
2022/09/12 16:48:06 ERROR : Attempt 2/3 failed with 1 errors and: folder not empty
2022/09/12 16:48:06 ERROR : Attempt 3/3 failed with 1 errors and: folder not empty
2022/09/12 16:48:06 Failed to rmdir: folder not empty
```

 So I tried listing the directory again with `lsl -v` and still got no info.  Tried again with `lsl -vv` and finally got some useful info:

```
rclone lsl -vv odc:audio/work/new/waiting/Johann_Sebastian_Bach_Canadian_Brass_-_Art_Of_The_Fugue
2022/09/12 16:50:19 DEBUG : rclone: Version "v1.59.2-beta.6379.603efbfe7" starting with parameters ["rclone" "lsl" "-vv" "odc:audio/work/new/waiting/Johann_Sebastian_Bach_Canadian_Brass_-_Art_Of_The_Fugue"]
2022/09/12 16:50:19 DEBUG : Creating backend with remote "odc:audio/work/new/waiting/Johann_Sebastian_Bach_Canadian_Brass_-_Art_Of_The_Fugue"
2022/09/12 16:50:19 DEBUG : Using config file from "<redacted>"
2022/09/12 16:50:19 DEBUG : Creating backend with remote "od:<redacted>"
2022/09/12 16:50:20 DEBUG : Starting OpenDrive session with ID: <redacted>
2022/09/12 16:50:22 DEBUG : 7lnt06c8j2d8pvtcjv5nav7r5leij3atc8nn371onikjps3jbqk8gscemr6fpeibni2pame6u9hmp32kq50llb81i7vf2sbgu3jifh9k9q542dgnp9b9hira8q0l23luc57me0lm0dreqce9tdmems3es9a7v9nnk82ljvbmmqvf4khe3s4r69ethvqjka3pvccub6bi3hftu623tnjonrtuq12i7atloj8g0oc4538kto2jtmgvjpbtj1bsb2d: Skipping undecryptable file name: not a multiple of blocksize
2022/09/12 16:50:22 DEBUG : m7tnlcgevcrm559nd6mctfirjnmcu6c8esth5esmcba052hqqk5vpav73h5i453353ndsjkbqvbq5n13fpbveqi0gm2j0ljlqdg9l3qv2h2lj9mrrt0mpd5ulebr49svbtbh2jmifsdgu5ha8e16nc6q240qjaufap950lu4b3a3e7dvj5demeqc52d9cp8t5cfj77a0tjbmmjq9m0ta21jqne22qp58l5htbqh4cnjrshrd8g21k5cuptoprum: Skipping undecryptable file name: not a multiple of blocksize
2022/09/12 16:50:22 DEBUG : 2 go routines active
>
```

So it appears there are two files that rclone is ignoring that exist in the directory it claims it is removing, yet it is still not removing the directory when `rclone sync` is used, and is not providing any warning or error messages about the removal failing without `-v` being used.

Attempting to `purge` these directories manually seems to work:

```
> rclone purge -v odc:audio/work/new/waiting/Johann_Sebastian_Bach_Canadian_Brass_-_Art_Of_The_Fugue
>
```

And a repeated purge shows that the directory is actually gone now:

```
> rclone purge -v odc:audio/work/new/waiting/Johann_Sebastian_Bach_Canadian_Brass_-_Art_Of_The_Fugue
2022/09/12 16:58:37 ERROR : Attempt 1/3 failed with 1 errors and: directory not found
2022/09/12 16:58:37 ERROR : Attempt 2/3 failed with 1 errors and: directory not found
2022/09/12 16:58:37 ERROR : Attempt 3/3 failed with 1 errors and: directory not found
2022/09/12 16:58:37 Failed to purge: directory not found
```

#### What is your rclone version (output from `rclone version`)

rclone v1.59.2-beta.6379.603efbfe7
- os/version: debian 11.4 (64 bit)
- os/kernel: 5.10.0-17-amd64 (x86_64)
- os/type: linux
- os/arch: amd64
- go/version: go1.17
- go/linking: dynamic
- go/tags: none

#### Which OS you are using and how many bits (e.g. Windows 7, 64 bit)

Debian 11.4

#### Which cloud storage system are you using? (e.g. Google Drive)

Opendrive with crypt remote
